edits.context:
He asks what happened at Wyvern Tor, so I give him the sequence.

“The party was in a cave, and then we sneakily attacked the sentry, and then took out the boss first, and then the entire party collapsed.”

I tell him about the bugbears fleeing and Gog remaining. Then I mention the thing that did not fit with the rest.

edits.before: “And he hides it again,” I say quietly.
edits.after: “And he hides it again?” I ask quietly.
edits.reason: Restore Zenvon's question and make the dependent attribution agree; Pip's next action confirms the inference.
edits.context:
That is enough information to watch him. I see nothing I can price. Pip does. Hamun’s interest rises for a moment at the mention of the black obelisk, then he hides it again.

“And he hides it again,” I say quietly.

Pip confirms it.

“For example, you see that sword you have?”

“Yes,” I say. “It's a… what that is… you know… made with… forged with diamonds and all the other precious stones.”

“It once belonged to a great knight named Aldith Tresendar, known as the Black Hawk.”

edits.after: “I just hope, you know, to keep up to his name when I use this sword. In combat.”

evidence.quote: "You know, to keep up to his name when I use this sword."

edits.context:
Hamun describes Aldith Tresendar arriving in black armor, his cape billowing, Talon in his hand.

Pip looks down at the sword. “I was… I just hope, you know, to keep up to his name when I use this sword. In combat.”

Hamun smiles. “Yes, Pip, I hope that for you too. And as I said, anything you find related to the Netherese, consider me your expert.”
